2 5.
Per contra, learned HCGP appearing for respondent No.1/State and learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2/complainant have opposed the bail petition.

They submit that the material on record would go to show that the victim was minor as on the date the petitioner took her along with him to Udupi and therefore, the alleged offences get attracted against him.
Accordingly, they pray to dismiss the petition.

6. The material on record would go to show that the victim, who is the daughter of the complainant had lived with the petitioner herein at Udupi and after she got pregnant, the petitioner had brought her back to her parent's house on 15.06.2023 and had left her in the said house.
The victim girl's date of birth is 21.01.2005.

The victim girl had allegedly given birth to a female child on 24.06.2023 in Haveri District Hospital and the said child had died after about a week at KIMS Hospital,
Hubballi.
The victim was subsequently shifted to SDM Hospital, Dharwad for better treatment.
However, she died in the NC: 2024:KHC-D:3327 hospital on 13.09.2023.
The allegation made in the complaint is that the petitioner and his family members were demanding dowry from the victim after her marriage with the petitioner.
Since the dowry demanded was not paid, the petitioner had brought the victim back to her parent's house.

It is also alleged in the complaint that on 09.09.2023,
petitioner allegedly tried to strangulate the neck of the complainant with the help of a towel.

All these allegations made in the complaint against the petitioner were found to be false and therefore,
charge sheet was filed by the police after investigation only for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 376(2)(n) and 504 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 4 and 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Undisputedly, as on the date of the complaint, the victim was aged about 18 years 6 months.
In the complaint as well as in the charge sheet, the particulars as to when the petitioner had taken the victim girl along with him is not found.
The petitioner is in custody from 14.09.2023.
Investigation in the case is complete and charge sheet is NC: 2024:KHC-D:3327 filed.
Petitioner is aged about 25 years and has no criminal antecedents.
Under the circumstances, I am of the opinion that the prayer made by the petitioner for grant of regular bail is required to be answered affirmatively.

Accordingly, the following:-
ORDER
The petition is allowed.

The petitioner is directed to be enlarged on bail in Spl.SC.No.81/2023 pending before the Court of Additional District and Sessions Judge, FTSC- I, Haveri, arising out of Crime No.55/2023 registered by Haveri Women Police Station, Haveri, for the offences punishable under Sections 363,
376(2)(n) and 504 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 4 and 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, subject to the following conditions:
i.
